title: Piezoelectric MEMS Accelerometer with Sub-Microgravity Resolution
abstract: A MEMS accelerometer with AlN piezoelectric sensing on silicon proof mass achieving 25 ng/sqrt(Hz) noise floor in 2mm x 2mm die.
claims: Silicon proof mass (500um x 500um x 50um) with folded-beam springs, k=0.5 N/m.
c-axis AlN sensing layer, 2um thick, by reactive sputtering.
Wafer-level vacuum packaging below 10 Pa for Q>1000.
problem_statement: Capacitive MEMS suffer parasitic capacitance and stiction. Piezoelectric sensing enables self-powered operation.
